title: Akbar ki jawani ko
body:
akbar ki jawani ko qaza maang rahi hai
zehra ke charaghon ko hawa maang rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
faryaad hai faryaad hai ya saaqi e kausar
pyason ka lahoo taygh e jafa maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko mere barchiyon waalon se bachale
laila ye musalle pe dua maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki khaatir jinhe maanga tha ali ne
un haathon ko ab karbobala maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ahmed ki nawasi pe ajab waqt pada hai
bazaar mein ek ek se rida maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye asr ka hangaam hai utho ali akbar
peeri shahe waala ki asa maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
suraj se kaho raat ke parde mein chala jaaye
ummat sar e zainab se rida maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ali asghar ko kaleje mein chupalo
ye chand bhi ghurbat ki ghata maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes se ghar laut ke aajao baradar
bemaar tumhari ye shifa maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kal dashte musibat mein jo mohtaje kafan tha
aaj us se kafan khalq e khuda maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lagta hai bilal aaj bhi shabbir ki beti
zindan se rehaai ki dua maang rahi hai
akbar ki jawani ko...
author: Bilal Kazmi
